== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later [[Evader (Errata)|Errata]] / [[Evader (PC Errata)|PC Errata]] articles of this family. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata only where those English articles are real. Do not add Revised, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
